test_Imagenet2012Test: test the Imagenet2012Test class that validates the ImageNet2012 dataset builder with train, validation, and test splits
test_Builder: test the imagenet2012_dataset_builder.Builder class for downloading and extracting ILSVRC2012 image archives
test_DatasetBuilderTestCase: test the testing.DatasetBuilderTestCase base class used to verify TensorFlow dataset builder correctness
test_test_main: test the testing.test_main entry point that runs the Imagenet2012Test unittest suite
test_module_overrides: test the PNG_IMAGES and CMYK_IMAGES module-level overrides used to mock image filenames in tests
